info.name: Treasure Data Access Control - Users API

request.description: Retrieves the resolved value of a single profile option for the specified user.
Sets the value of a profile option for the specified user. Admin only.
Removes a profile option for the specified user, reverting it to the account default. Admin only.
Retrieves all profile option keys with their resolved values for the specified user.
Retrieves a list of users and their permissions.
Retrieves a list of users attached to a policy.
Updates users attached to a policy.
